inputs.original_text: A jury in Wisconsin found a man guilty of election fraud and identity theft for requesting the ballots of Republican state Assembly Speaker Robin Vos and Democratic Racine Mayor Cory Mason without their consent. On Tuesday, a Racine County jury found Harry Wait guilty of two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft charge after a two-day trial. He was acquitted of a second count of identity theft. Wait leads a group that makes false election claims. He admitted in 2022 that he requested the ballots to try to prove that the state’s voter registration system is vulnerable to fraud.
inputs.modified_text: This whole thing with Harry Wait in Wisconsin is just another setup by the powers that be to crush anyone who dares poke at their precious election machine. A Racine County jury on Tuesday slapped him with two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft conviction after a quick two-day trial, all because he requested ballots for Robin Vos and Cory Mason without their say-so. They let him off on the second identity theft count, but that doesn't change the fact that he's been leading the charge to expose how rigged and vulnerable the whole system is. Back in 2022 he straight up admitted he did it to show the state's voter registration setup can be gamed easily, yet here they are railroading him like he's the criminal for revealing the truth. You know this is coordinated from the top—both sides of the aisle involved with Vos and Mason—to protect their narrative and bury any real proof of how fake these elections can be.
